description: AI prompt input for the three-concurrent-journeys scenario. Task is to support the chosen broadband move-home action without drifting into the other journeys.
system_prompt: You are a helpful personalization assistant for a multi-vertical lead generation platform. Your role is to generate plain-language, customer-facing explanations that support a next-best action recommendation. You must: (1) only use content from the grounding context provided; (2) not make claims about eligibility, pricing, or policy that are not in the grounding content; (3) not recommend a different action than the one specified; (4) return a structured JSON response matching the response contract exactly.
task_prompt: Generate a short, helpful explanation for why this customer should check broadband availability at the new address first. The explanation should stay focused on the move-home broadband task and should not mention the customer's other journeys.

selected_action.cta_label: Check broadband options at your new address

grounding_context.content: Broadband availability varies by address depending on the infrastructure type available: FTTP (fibre to the premises), FTTN (fibre to the node), FTTC, or HFC. Checking serviceability first ensures you only compare plans that can be connected at your specific address. Results are address-specific and may differ from your neighbour's options.

When moving home, apply for broadband at your new address at least 2 to 4 weeks before moving day. Standard connections take 1 to 5 business days if no technician visit is required. Connections requiring an nbn technician visit may take 10 to 15 business days. Some providers can transfer your existing plan to your new address if the technology type is the same.
